title:
Specifies the existence of `ChartInfoTransformMap.ts` for the UiBundler.
This file imports all the transforms that could potentially be used in {@link ChartInfoApplicationState}
and returns them in a map of transform name to transform function.
The ts file should be editted or overriden to contain every possible transform that can be returned by
{@link ChartHelper#getChartInfo}.
name: ChartInfoTransformMap
